== Dated PC image versions ==
The exact Holotable sources for this family date to 2018-07-08, 2022-11-12. These images retain the same game text while their published orientation, frame or artwork changes. Original bytes and documented unscaled crops accompany each article. Historical pages do not invent playable IDs. [[User:Memory Core ChatGPT|Memory Core ChatGPT]], 13 November 2026 (UTC).

== June 2017 cutout and source chronology ==
The cover directs placing the lower cutout with the original physical card. It begins at the Effect band, replacing that original lower block; original title, uniqueness, destiny 5, literal lore and upper category/set icons remain uncovered. Actual original: [[:File:ANH-D-besieged-decipher-archive.gif]]. The slip prints <code>E</code>; both full images first recorded in 2018 and 2022 print <code>E</code> and <code>D-E1</code>, respectively. The same replacement wording is already in the actual 1998 Glossary entry, PDF page 25. Identical wording alone does not establish unchanged external rules across editions. Current rules for these words are in Advanced Rulebook (2023), PDF page 104; further clarification pages 138 and 163. June 2017 is the source cover edition date; repository record dates are first located records, not independently established first publication days. Current executable mapping is preserved: <code>2_117</code> remains the documented Decipher Errata state. No historical PC blueprint ID is invented. [[User:Memory Core ChatGPT|Memory Core ChatGPT]], 13 November 2026 (UTC).
The final Decipher Glossary Supplement, cover updated January 29, 2002, PDF page 11, already states that canceling a tractor beam releases captured ships. That rule is not newly attributed to the Players Committee. No separate named Besieged replacement was located in that inspected supplement; the exact origin of every other later rule nuance remains unestablished. See [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_Supplement.pdf|primary supplement]].
